game.title: Bulletstorm
game.blurb: First-person shooter built around Skillshots, from People Can Fly and Epic Games, published by Electronic Arts, released 2011-02-22. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes (Full Clip Edition app).

chapters.title: The Campaign: Early Story
chapters.summary: The first story beats in the achievements, from meeting your new best friend to rescuing the princess.

chapters.title: The Campaign: Later Story
chapters.summary: Later story beats, from major destruction and the back yard to catching a ride. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Set-Piece Feats
chapters.summary: The dance floor, the helicopter in the park, the rooftop barrels, the collapsed building, the jumpship sprint, the escape capsule, flytraps and early headshots.

chapters.title: Newsbots, Electroflies and Nom Juice
chapters.summary: Destroying Newsbots and Electroflies, and drinking or destroying bottles of Nom Juice.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Very Easy or Easy, Normal, Hard and Very Hard.

chapters.title: Skillshots
chapters.summary: Performing 10 different Skillshots up to every Single Player Skillshot, and 2000 points at once.

chapters.title: Echoes Mode
chapters.summary: Stars, scores and Skillshot feats in Echoes.

chapters.title: Anarchy Mode
chapters.summary: Minibosses, team score, team challenges, level 30 and environmental Skillshots.

chapters.title: Map Challenges
chapters.summary: Ten feats tied to named maps, from Guns of Stygia and Crash Site to Hotel Elysium, Villa, Sewer, Mean Street, Monorail Factory, Rock Quarry, Ulysses and Mini City.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected 2011 entry "bulletstorm" (id 4602); RAWG keeps "Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition" (id 9659, 2017-04-07) separately and lists it as this game's only addition. The Steam store list has no app for the 2011 release; it has "Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition" (501590) and "Bulletstorm VR" (2451320). The Full Clip Edition is the edition on sale, so its achievements were used (60, none hidden); it may differ from the 2011 release. StrategyWiki has no page under "Bulletstorm" or "Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition". bulletstorm.fandom.com answers the API under "Bulletstorm" but with only 16 linked articles, so it says little; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The eleven story achievements do not name acts; they are ordered by unlock rate (79.6% for "Fits Like a Glove" down to 32.0% for "Stowaway") and split into two halves, our own choice. The ten map achievements (Last_Blood to Barber in the list, about 1.5% each) name maps but not a mode; they are kept in their own chapter rather than guessed into Anarchy or Echoes.
